```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 09 — Spatial inferCNV analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Infer broad copy-number-associated expression patterns in tumor-bearing
#   Visium spatial transcriptomic samples using inferCNV.
#
#   Spatial cluster 6 represents the candidate cancer-associated region and is
#   assigned as the inferCNV observation group. All remaining clusters within
#   each tumor-bearing slide are used as reference spots.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Reference:
#   reference/
#     mouse_GRCm38_genome_infercnv.txt
#
# Outputs:
#   data/processed/spatial/infercnv/
#   results/spatial/infercnv/
#   figures/spatial/infercnv/
#
# inferCNV parameters:
#   Assay:              Spatial
#   Expression:         raw counts
#   Observation:        spatial cluster 6
#   Reference:          all remaining spatial clusters
#   Cutoff:             0.1
#   Denoise:            TRUE
#   HMM:                TRUE
#   Cluster by groups:  TRUE
#   Threads:            4
#   Leiden resolution:  0.01
#
# Notes:
#   - inferCNV is run independently for each tumor-bearing spatial slide.
#   - Normal_Tissue is excluded from inferCNV analysis.
#   - Raw Spatial counts are used rather than SCT-normalized expression.
#   - Cluster 6 is treated as a candidate tumor-associated observation region.
#   - inferCNV provides expression-based evidence consistent with broad CNV
#     events and does not constitute direct DNA-based evidence of malignancy.
#   - CNV scoring and malignant-region classification are performed downstream.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(infercnv)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

sample_column <- "sample"
cluster_column <- "spatial_cluster"
annotation_column <- "infercnv_input_group"

observation_cluster <- "6"

tumor_samples <- c(
  "Niacin_Treatment",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2"
)

normal_sample <- "Normal_Tissue"

infercnv_cutoff <- 0.1
num_threads <- 4
run_hmm <- TRUE
leiden_resolution <- 0.01

excluded_chromosomes <- c(
  "chrX",
  "chrY",
  "chrM"
)


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

infercnv_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

reference_directory <- here::here(
  "reference"
)


for (directory in c(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

gene_order_file <- file.path(
  reference_directory,
  "mouse_GRCm38_genome_infercnv.txt"
)

prepared_object_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  "infercnv_prepared_spatial_objects.rds"
)

parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_parameters.csv"
)

input_group_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_input_group_summary.csv"
)

analysis_manifest_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_analysis_manifest.csv"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load and prepare spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {

  stop(
    "Module 07 spatial object not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}


if (!file.exists(gene_order_file)) {

  stop(
    "inferCNV gene-order file not found: ",
    gene_order_file
  )
}


message(
  "Loading processed spatial object..."
)


spatial_object <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


if (!spatial_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)) {

  stop(
    "Required Spatial assay was not found."
  )
}


required_metadata <- c(
  sample_column,
  cluster_column
)


missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)
)


if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Required metadata missing: ",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- spatial_assay


# Join multiple raw-count layers before extracting inferCNV input.

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[spatial_assay]]
)


if (sum(grepl("^counts", spatial_layers)) > 1) {

  message(
    "Joining Spatial count layers..."
  )

  spatial_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_object,
    assay = spatial_assay
  )
}


spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[spatial_assay]]
)


if (!"counts" %in% spatial_layers) {

  stop(
    "Raw Spatial counts are not available."
  )
}


# Confirm expected samples are present.

expected_samples <- c(
  normal_sample,
  tumor_samples
)


missing_samples <- setdiff(
  expected_samples,
  unique(
    as.character(
      spatial_object[[sample_column]][, 1]
    )
  )
)


if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Expected spatial samples missing: ",
    paste(
      missing_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


message(
  "Loaded ",
  ncol(spatial_object),
  " spots across ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object[[sample_column]][, 1]
    )
  ),
  " samples."
)


print(
  table(
    spatial_object[[sample_column]][, 1]
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Validate gene-order reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gene_order <- utils::read.delim(
  gene_order_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


if (ncol(gene_order) < 4) {

  stop(
    "inferCNV gene-order file must contain at least four columns."
  )
}


gene_order <- gene_order[, 1:4]


colnames(gene_order) <- c(
  "gene",
  "chromosome",
  "start",
  "end"
)


shared_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(spatial_object),
  gene_order$gene
)


if (length(shared_genes) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No genes overlap between the Spatial assay and inferCNV gene-order file."
  )
}


gene_order_summary <- data.frame(

  spatial_genes = nrow(spatial_object),

  gene_order_genes = nrow(gene_order),

  shared_genes = length(shared_genes),

  shared_percent =
    100 *
    length(shared_genes) /
    nrow(spatial_object)
)


print(
  gene_order_summary
)


utils::write.csv(
  gene_order_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_gene_order_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare tumor-bearing samples and inferCNV groups
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Normal tissue is retained separately but is not included in inferCNV.

normal_seurat <- subset(
  spatial_object,
  subset = sample == normal_sample
)


sample_objects <- lapply(
  tumor_samples,
  function(sample_name) {

    subset(
      spatial_object,
      subset = sample == sample_name
    )
  }
)


names(sample_objects) <- tumor_samples


# Assign cluster 6 as the observation region.
# All remaining clusters are used as references.

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {

  sample_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]


  sample_clusters <- as.character(
    sample_object[[cluster_column]][, 1]
  )


  if (!observation_cluster %in% sample_clusters) {

    stop(
      "Observation cluster ",
      observation_cluster,
      " was not found in ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }


  sample_object[[annotation_column]] <- ifelse(
    sample_clusters == observation_cluster,
    "observation",
    "reference"
  )


  sample_objects[[sample_name]] <- sample_object
}


# Summarize reference and observation spots.

input_group_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(sample_objects),
    function(sample_name) {

      sample_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]


      data.frame(
        sample = sample_name,
        group = sample_object[[annotation_column]][, 1]
      ) %>%
        dplyr::count(
          sample,
          group,
          name = "spots"
        )
    }
  )
)


print(
  input_group_summary
)


utils::write.csv(
  input_group_summary,
  input_group_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Save prepared objects for downstream CNV scoring.

prepared_objects <- list(
  normal = normal_seurat,
  tumor_samples = sample_objects
)


saveRDS(
  prepared_objects,
  prepared_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Visualize inferCNV input regions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# These plots provide a spatial sanity check that cluster 6 corresponds
# to the candidate cancer-associated tissue region.

spatial_images <- c(
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin2_B5",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle1_C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle2_D5"
)


cluster_plots <- list()
input_group_plots <- list()


for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {

  sample_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]


  cluster_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    sample_object,
    images = spatial_images[[sample_name]],
    group.by = cluster_column,
    label = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_name,
        ": spatial clusters"
      )
    )


  print(
    cluster_plot
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_spatial_clusters.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = cluster_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )


  cluster_plots[[sample_name]] <- cluster_plot


  input_group_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    sample_object,
    images = spatial_images[[sample_name]],
    group.by = annotation_column
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_name,
        ": inferCNV input groups"
      )
    )


  print(
    input_group_plot
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_infercnv_input_groups.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = input_group_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )


  input_group_plots[[sample_name]] <- input_group_plot
}


# Save a combined overview of inferCNV observation/reference regions.

input_group_overview <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  input_group_plots,
  nrow = 1
)


print(
  input_group_overview
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_input_groups_all_slides.png"
  ),
  plot = input_group_overview,
  width = 18,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Run inferCNV
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_spatial_infercnv <- function(
    seurat_object,
    sample_name
) {

  message(
    "Running inferCNV: ",
    sample_name
  )


  raw_counts <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
    object = seurat_object,
    assay = spatial_assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )


  annotation <- data.frame(

    spot = colnames(
      seurat_object
    ),

    group = as.character(
      seurat_object[[annotation_column]][, 1]
    ),

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  group_counts <- table(
    annotation$group
  )


  if (
    !"reference" %in% names(group_counts) ||
    !"observation" %in% names(group_counts)
  ) {

    stop(
      "Both reference and observation spots are required for ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }


  message(
    "  Reference spots: ",
    group_counts["reference"],
    " | Observation spots: ",
    group_counts["observation"]
  )


  sample_output_directory <- file.path(
    results_directory,
    sample_name
  )


  dir.create(
    sample_output_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )


  annotation_file <- file.path(
    sample_output_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_annotations.tsv"
    )
  )


  utils::write.table(
    annotation,
    file = annotation_file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )


  infercnv_object <- infercnv::CreateInfercnvObject(

    raw_counts_matrix = raw_counts,

    annotations_file = annotation_file,

    delim = "\t",

    gene_order_file = gene_order_file,

    ref_group_names = "reference",

    chr_exclude = excluded_chromosomes
  )


  infercnv_result <- infercnv::run(

    infercnv_object,

    cutoff = infercnv_cutoff,

    out_dir = sample_output_directory,

    cluster_by_groups = TRUE,

    denoise = TRUE,

    HMM = run_hmm,

    num_threads = num_threads,

    leiden_resolution = leiden_resolution,

    plot_steps = FALSE
  )


  result_file <- file.path(
    sample_output_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_result.rds"
    )
  )


  saveRDS(
    infercnv_result,
    result_file,
    compress = TRUE
  )


  return(
    data.frame(

      sample = sample_name,

      input_spots = ncol(raw_counts),

      reference_spots =
        as.numeric(
          group_counts["reference"]
        ),

      observation_spots =
        as.numeric(
          group_counts["observation"]
        ),

      annotation_file = annotation_file,

      result_file = result_file,

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}


# Run each tumor-bearing slide independently.

analysis_manifest <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(sample_objects),
    function(sample_name) {

      run_spatial_infercnv(
        seurat_object = sample_objects[[sample_name]],
        sample_name = sample_name
      )
    }
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save analysis summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

print(
  analysis_manifest
)


utils::write.csv(
  analysis_manifest,
  analysis_manifest_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


infercnv_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "assay",
    "expression_layer",
    "observation_cluster",
    "reference_definition",
    "cutoff",
    "denoise",
    "HMM",
    "cluster_by_groups",
    "threads",
    "leiden_resolution",
    "excluded_chromosomes"
  ),

  value = c(
    spatial_assay,
    "counts",
    observation_cluster,
    "all remaining clusters",
    infercnv_cutoff,
    TRUE,
    run_hmm,
    TRUE,
    num_threads,
    leiden_resolution,
    paste(
      excluded_chromosomes,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


utils::write.csv(
  infercnv_parameters,
  parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Complete module
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Module 09 complete: inferCNV run for ",
  length(tumor_samples),
  " tumor-bearing spatial slides using cluster ",
  observation_cluster,
  " as the observation region."
)

```
